title: Class sizes
statementMd:
How many enrollments does each course have? Show title and count, largest first (ties by title).

Expected columns: `title`, `enrolled`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.title, COUNT(*) AS enrolled FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY enrolled DESC, c.title;
```
